note: Held-weapon fits per weapon and character, set by the user in the Rig Lab fit panel (beside the X Bot / Quaternius mannequin), applied by render/holdfit.js in both the Rig Lab and the game: size %, a move in mm along the weapon's own axes (fwd = its long axis, up = model +Y, side = model +X), a turn in degrees (tilt about +X, turn about +Y, roll about the long axis), pivoting on the grip point. The pistol's fits are in pistol_fit.json.
